material.description: CISA primer identifies infrastructure dependencies as factors that can affect community risk and resilience and frames understanding essential functions/services, supporting systems and interdependencies as part of planning. This is qualitative support only; the cited page does not quantify dependency effects or establish universal failure/recovery causal pathways.
material.locator: CISA, The Infrastructure Dependency Primer (as of June 2, 2023), p. 1, Overview and Learn module.
